detaileddescription.para: If the given initialized name (located in the given scope) has an initializer, returns a new expression statement equivalent to the initializer.

simplesect.para: 'name' must correspond to a variable declaration in 'scope'.
The new statement, or 0 if none the initialized name does not have an initializer.

xrefdescription.para: Currently works only for SgAssignInitializers on non-reference primitive types. SgAggregateInitializers will return 0.

detaileddescription.para: If the given initialized name has an initializer, create an expression statement equivalent to the initializer and append that statement to the target basic block.

simplesect.para: 'name' must correspond to a variable declaration in 'scope'.
true if an initializer exists, and false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Preprocessor phase to convert a statement into an SgBasicBlock.
